subject: Marketplace listing: approval checklist & co-sell playbook review
content:
From: Samantha Clayton <samantha@cloudbridge.io>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 7 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: AWS listing kickoff + draft assets attached

Hi Irene —

Thanks again for taking this on. Attached is our first pass at the AWS Marketplace listing and a short co-sell playbook that CloudBridge uses when bringing ISVs live. Key asks from our side:
- Quick copy pass focusing the hero on measurable benefits (TCO per request, latency uplift).
- A short bulleted "Why choose Redwood Inference" (3 bullets) suitable for the AWS product page.
- Confirmation of the SKU/pricing blurb (we need exact wording for minimum commitment and included support).

I attached: aws_listing_draft.docx, product_hero_3up.png, co-sell_playbook_v2.pdf.

Can you loop in product marketing and legal when you have a copy-ready version? Our procurement lead (procurement@wellness-retail.com) will also want pricing language for the contract.

Best,
Samantha
CloudBridge — Partner Programs

---

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Clayton <samantha@cloudbridge.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 7 Nov 2026 12:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS listing kickoff + draft assets attached

Samantha —

Received, thanks. Quick read-through from our side: I'll do the hero and positioning edits and send a copy pass by end of day Sunday PST. Marcus and Karthik, adding you for technical accuracy (model names, runtime claims) and pricing constraints.

Initial notes:
- We should avoid absolute latency numbers unless benchmarked on the Marketplace-supported instance types.
- "Pay-per-token" line: our marketplace SKU should say "usage-based pricing" and link to the pricing sheet — legal flagged commitment language.
- Co-sell playbook: looks good but needs an explicit "who to contact at Redwood" section (SE + Partner AM).

Irene
Sr. Product Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference

---

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Samantha Clayton <samantha@cloudbridge.io>
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 14:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS listing kickoff + draft assets attached

All —

I pulled the draft into the doc and added inline comments for the technical claim set. Highlights:
- "Up to 40% cost reduction" -> comment: need benchmark link or change to "typical improvements" and cite internal eval id.
- Model names: we can't publish internal build tags; use public model IDs (e.g., redwood-ml/gpt-large-v2) and a compatibility note for accelerators (A10G, H100).
- KV cache & batching blurb: shorten to one sentence and add a link to the Optimize whitepaper rather than a long paragraph.

Two asks for Product Marketing:
1) Shorten the hero to a single-line benefit + 1-sentence subhead. Current hero is feature-heavy.
2) Pricing blurb: add a parenthetical about minimum monthly invoice if applicable (Marcus — please confirm legal constraints).

For the co-sell playbook, I'm proposing we add a 1-page Snapshot that the AWS seller can forward to prospects (Problem, Solution, 3 outcomes, Next step). That will live as a PDF asset (can be the front page of co-sell_playbook_v2.pdf).

-Marcus
Principal Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference

---

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Clayton <samantha@cloudbridge.io>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 02:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS listing kickoff + draft assets attached

Samantha / team —

Thanks for the draft and the suggested playbook. Irene and Marcus, your comments are on point; I've taken the copy edits and produced a tightened hero and new 3-bullet "Why Redwood" that reads well on the Marketplace product detail page.

Action items (owner -> due):
- Irene: finalize headline + subhead (done) and upload final docx to the Drive link (due 2026-11-09T12:00:00Z).
- Karthik: confirm allowed technical claims and the minimum invoice phrasing for legal (due 2026-11-09T18:00:00Z).
- Marcus: produce the 1-page co-sell Snapshot PDF for seller enablement (due 2026-11-10T00:00:00Z).
- Samantha: confirm whether CloudBridge wants the Snapshot customized with their logo (optional).

I've also created a HubSpot draft deal (link above). Once Karthik confirms pricing language, I'll route to Legal for an accelerated review (we have a 48-hour turnaround window for marketplace copy approvals if everything else is green).

If there are no further material edits I will mark the listing as "ready for marketplace submission" and start the AWS onboarding checklist.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of GTM Partnerships | Redwood Inference

[Attachments referenced: aws_listing_draft.docx (v1.2), co-sell_playbook_v2.pdf, product_hero_3up.png]
